metadata.case_name: GABY ANDERSON v. WUI YIP CO. LTD. AND OTHERS

source: Whiplash injury with tenderness over the cervical spine and limitation of movements in all directions;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified strain or sprain of cervical spine

injuries.description: Extensive abrasions, bruising and swelling to her right elbow, right forearm and right hand
injuries.body_part: right elbow, right forearm, right hand
source: At the hospital she was found to have extensive abrasions, bruising and swelling to her right elbow, right forearm and right hand.
Extensive soft tissue injury to the right elbow, forearm and wrist;

injuries.description: Possible trauma to the deep flexor tendon of the small finger
source: Possible trauma to the deep flexor tendon of the small finger;
injuries.icd_description: Injury of flexor muscle, fascia or tendon of other finger at wrist or hand level, unspecified

injuries.description: Chest wall trauma with bruising but no rib fracture
source: Chest wall trauma with bruising but no rib fracture;

injuries.description: Adjustment disorder after the whiplash injury
source: the plaintiff, apart from her whiplash injury, is also suffering in the psychiatric aspect an adjustment disorder after the whiplash injury.

manifestations.description: Intermittent neck pain of a tight character
Bilateral headache of a dragging and tight character
Being upset and frustrated because of her neck pain and headache (emotional distress / anxiety)
Tenderness over the cervical spine and limitation of movements in all directions
Chest pain and chest wall bruising

treatments_received: ambulance transport to United Christian Hospital
treatments_future: medical consultations for symptomatic treatment by a neurologist or neurosurgeon about once a month for six months, then twice-monthly for six months, with possible continuation twice-monthly thereafter
physiotherapy (estimated one session per month ongoing)
psychiatric supportive psychotherapy and pharmacotherapy (course of six to eight sessions)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Before the accident the plaintiff enjoyed swimming, tennis and aerobics. Since the accident her sporting life has been greatly curtailed because of the neck pain and headache; tennis and aerobics are out for her.
She cannot pick up and cuddle her children when they fall; inability to breastfeed.
Permanent and recurrent neck pain and stiffness compromising quality of life and general activities.
Impaired memory and psychiatric disturbance (adjustment disorder) requiring psychiatric treatment.
Need to continue physiotherapy and acupuncture for relief and some limitations in daily activities (e.g. childcare tasks).
the plaintiff, apart from her whiplash injury, is also suffering in the psychiatric aspect an adjustment disorder after the whiplash injury.
